title: AI Agents Working for You While You Sleep! 😴
body: AI Agents Working for You While You Sleep! 😴
OpenAI has launched 'Dots': always-on agents inside ChatGPT, each with its own cloud computer, that keep working on your goal between conversations and can access more than 4,000 apps.
The service has launched for ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers.
What would you ask an agent that works for you all day? 💭
